title.zh: 布鲁克林检方捣毁针对俄语使用者的加密骗局背后112台服务器
title.en: Brooklyn Prosecutors Take Down 112 Servers Behind Crypto Scam Targeting Russian Speakers

current_state.zh: 布鲁克林检察官和FBI查封或干扰了与一个针对俄语裔美国人的加密投资诈骗相关的112台服务器和241个网站；该骗局据称窃取数千万美元，目前已查获约30万美元，未宣布逮捕，调查人员称行动针对后端服务器以阻止替换网站出现。
current_state.en: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI have seized or disrupted 112 servers and 241 websites tied to a Russian-language crypto investment scam that allegedly stole tens of millions from Russian-speaking U.S. victims; about $300,000 has been seized, no arrests were announced, and investigators targeted backend servers to prevent replacement sites.

updates.what_changed_en: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI disrupted 112 servers and 241 web domains tied to a multinational crypto investment scam that targeted Russian-speaking Americans and stole tens of millions of dollars, seizing about $300,000 in stolen funds so far.

updates.title_zh: 布鲁克林检方和FBI如何捣毁一个针对俄语使用者的庞大加密欺诈网络
updates.title_en: How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：该行动于上周执行，源自三年调查，基础设施涉及乌克兰及其他东欧国家；未宣布逮捕；诈骗者还以虚假资金追回服务二次接触受害者；布鲁克林地区检察官虚拟货币部门此前已查封或干扰约400个相关域名。
updates.what_changed_en: New details: the operation was carried out last week after a three-year investigation, involved infrastructure in Ukraine and other Eastern European countries, no arrests were announced, scammers re-contacted victims with fake recovery offers, and the DA's Virtual Currency Unit had previously seized or disrupted about 400 related domains.
updates.current_state_zh: 布鲁克林检察官和FBI查封或干扰了与一个针对俄语裔美国人的加密投资诈骗相关的112台服务器和241个网站；该骗局据称窃取数千万美元，目前已查获约30万美元，未宣布逮捕，调查人员称行动针对后端服务器以阻止替换网站出现。
updates.current_state_en: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI have seized or disrupted 112 servers and 241 websites tied to a Russian-language crypto investment scam that allegedly stole tens of millions from Russian-speaking U.S. victims; about $300,000 has been seized, no arrests were announced, and investigators targeted backend servers to prevent replacement sites.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized or disrupted 241 scam websites and 112 servers tied to a Russian-language crypto investment fraud that allegedly stole tens of millions from Russian-speaking victims in the U.S., with victims then targeted by fake recovery offers.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized or disrupted 241 scam websites and 112 servers tied to a Russian-language crypto investment fraud that allegedly stole tens of millions from Russian-speaking victims in the U.S., with victims then targeted by fake recovery offers.
